changes.comment: BREAKING (implementers only): ICryptoProvider gains required generateHmacKey and importHmacKey, which create HMAC-SHA256 CryptoKeys with sign/verify usages, non-extractable by default (import refuses keys shorter than 32 bytes); implemented by NodeCryptoProvider. Adds IHmacKeyOptions and Constants.HMAC_SHA256_KEY_SIZE, and corrects the hmacSha256 docs to point at importHmacKey instead of crypto.subtle.importKey
